note.value: This Stone requires the constant chants of Dark Elf Priestesses to maintain control over its evil sentience. When it does the bidding of the Dark Elves it viciously strikes out with its negative energy, but sometimes it demands sacrifices or it will destroy the ship it is on.

Restriction: Black Ark Only

Every turn, just before you move the Black Ark, roll D6. On a roll of 4+ Urkarontir performs a 3 dice attack with a -3 save modifier directed in a D6 direction from the Black Ark. On a roll of 2 or 3 nothing happens this turn. A roll of 1 means the Black Ark either loses one crew counter or suffers D3 hits on Low locations.
